Regenerating in the main checkout now yields 14 gates all fresh/pass. The unknown verdicts were written while the floor agent's mutation test had buildGraph gutted, so the graph genuinely carried no claims at that instant and the artifact faithfully recorded a mutated tree. THE GENERAL HAZARD, which is what makes this worth recording: a mutation test that runs a command which WRITES generated artifacts leaves those artifacts describing the mutated tree after the mutation is reverted, because reverting the source does not re-run the generator. The artifacts then read as a regression to the next reader. Mutation testing should either run only non-writing commands or regenerate artifacts as its last step
